title: More Workers, a Slower Provider
description: Receipt jobs are backing up because an email provider is already at its request limit. The database is healthy. Which change addresses the actual pressure?

options.text: Add read replicas to the order database.
options.explanation: Read capacity does not change the provider's delivery limit.

options.text: Double workers and retry all rejected sends immediately.
options.explanation: This pushes more traffic at the saturated dependency and can amplify throttling.

options.text: Shard order IDs so every worker has a new range.
options.explanation: Reassigning keys does not raise an external provider's capacity.

options.text: Bound send concurrency, back off on throttling and monitor queue age.
options.explanation: The queue buys time, while bounded workers respect downstream capacity. Queue age shows whether the sustained deficit needs more provider capacity or admission control.
